findings.evidence: The proof says “a linear map on ℝⁿ with trivial kernel is bijective,” citing [[def-invertible-matrix-and-general-linear-group]]. That dependency only defines invertibility as the existence of B with AB=Iₙ=BA; it does not prove that an injective endomorphism of ℝⁿ is surjective. The same finite-dimensional fact is also needed to define (M^{1/2})^{-1}. Rank-nullity closes this gap immediately, so it is nonfatal.
